Participant detail with contacts, selected destinations, scope, version, relationships, and history.
Segment collection with active version, search, versions, publication, activation, and retirement state.

Complete inspection workspace connecting evidence, origin, project/stage, report, publication, and recapture.

Versioned readable report detail with canonical/rendered views, analysis provenance, and publication history; a v3 move-out report carries the complete baseline comparison (every included item with one evidence-backed outcome, the baseline version as issued and stable outcome counts) and its `inventory` section states the same per-item results and counts, with `coverage.noBasis` apart from `notObserved` and a "no basis" item never stating a baseline condition. The internal projection also exposes formatted attribute sources, evidence notices, assessed extent, unassessed portions, analysis scope and reason labels; comparison purpose/outcome labels are shared with PDF/HTML.
Observable preparation, integrity digest, supported kind, and authorized time-limited download.
Scoped summary whose counts match active filters and expose freshness.
Filtered, paginated priority queue linked to complete inspection workspaces.
Ordered stage/inspection timeline with state, occurrence time, and navigable relationships.
Delivery collection with intent, channel attempts, partial failure, retry state, and related resource.
Governance form/detail with restrictive default, version, scope, customer effect, and history.
Customer-safe portfolio includes only assets with a published report or active inventory; scopes, search and cursor pagination are enforced.
Real customer-safe chronological projection with no internal notes or hidden state.

Active policy-approved report with safe unavailable/invalidated behavior; the customer comparison keeps the whole baseline denominator under the optional `comparisonOutcome` filter, and an invalid filter or version reference returns no data from another report. Paired-image availability follows the same screening triage as the customer PDF, and `inventory.coverage.noBasis` keeps items without baseline basis apart from `notObserved`. The Dashboard customer screen uses the allowlisted Portuguese checklist labels and E### references directly, shows the evidence notice and permitted scope/reason labels, labels `NO_BASIS` entries "Sem base para comparar", and never presents an unknown status as a change. Processing messages use the customer-safe report vocabulary. Evidence: UT-078, UT-079, IT-022, TestTask05R2CustomerComparisonAppliesTheCustomerPDFScreening, TestTask05R2NoBasisIsNeverNotObservedInAnySection, apps/dashboard tests/unit/inventory-no-basis.test.ts
Policy-approved evidence allowlist, lineage, availability, pagination, and time-limited media access.
Paginated notification center with unread count, authorized resource links, and read state.
Current policy/history plus legal-hold, deletion, purge eligibility/progress, and tombstone entry points.
Period-filtered requests, tokens, cost, freshness, timezone, and authorized export context.
Per-inspection durable LLM attempts, known usage/cost, incomplete coverage, and safe correlation details.

Inventory operators open one authorized transcript note with its revisions, media anchor, processing status, and audio availability.

capabilities.journey: A manager or employee with report correction permission decides the evidence pairing of one baseline item of a v3 move-out comparison against the latest report version; the decision opens a new comparison generation of that item's room only (other rooms and other items keep their results) that issues the next report version while earlier versions stay unchanged. Cross-room evidence, photos of a superseded submission or open recapture, stale versions, a `clientMutationId` reused with another decision and internal viewers are refused. The new generation copies exactly the previous generation of the room (results, matcher and staff pairs), judging again the revised item, a staff decision whose judgment failed and items paired with a replaced photo.
